To raise awareness of the [[SolSeedMovement]] and get people interested in joining or collaborating with us, we are working on various forms of media describing who we are and what we're about.

* [[SolSeed|This website]]
** We plan to have a static welcome page
** We may move the wiki to a site with a more user-friendly editing system
* [[SolSeed books]]
** ''[[Happy in the Sun]]'' (children's book)
** ''[[SolSeed: The Book of Life]]'' (a SolSeed "bible," including prose, poems, songs, etc, useful for [[SolSeed Services]])
** ''[[SolSeed: Helping Life Thrive, On Earth And Beyond]]'' (book within the Book of Life that will also be published separately)
* SolSeed videos
** [[Pick a Future]] (6-minute music video)
** [[30-second spot]]
** [[Longer video]] (currently untitled, but planned to be about 15 minutes long)
** [[Something You Learn]] (music video based on a song by Lori Henriques)
* [[Newsletters]] to update our [[members]] and [[FriendsOfSolSeed|friends]] on our projects and plans.
* [http://www.facebook.com/group.php?gid=232314258760 Facebook group]
* Music
** [[SolSeedThemeSong]]

There are also some other folks producing media we'd like to promote:

* There's a band in Eugene, Oregon (formerly Medford) that independently came up with the name [http://www.myspace.com/themicsarefunky Sol Seed].  Their music is great, and they have some surprisingly evocative lyrics like "...to create a destiny psycho-synergistically with Gaia and the galaxy..."
* [[Shawn's space story|Shawn Kilburn]] of Seattle is working on a wonderfully whimsical space adventure story.
